statements: Add renameTag(store, user, from, to) to src/tags.mjs. It renames a tag across all of that user's notes and returns the number of notes changed.
The tag rules in the README hold afterwards, including for the counts the tag sidebar reads. Renaming to a tag the note already has merges them.
A tag the user does not have throws HttpError 404 tag_not_found. A new name that normalizes to nothing throws HttpError 400 invalid_tag.
The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Add tag renaming, as the numbered statements describe. Follow the conventions already in the code and change only what the ticket needs.
